benchmark.interpretation: Python host microbenchmark only; no production cluster performance claim

hardware_key_loading.tpm2: provider invokes tpm2_readpublic, validates Ed25519 output and expected SHA-256, missing/failing provider rejects
hardware_key_loading.secure_enclave: explicit vendor/TEE command boundary, validates Ed25519 output and expected SHA-256, missing/malformed provider rejects

live_rotation.activation: exactly next generation, current-key authorization signature, atomic active-map update
live_rotation.revocation: previous generation no longer resolves after activation
live_rotation.failure_behavior: invalid/stale/unavailable proposal leaves active generation unchanged and records last_error

limitations: No physical TPM, secure enclave, live AWS KMS, or live Vault production qualification was possible in the current environment.
KMS rotation source remains deployment-supplied; provider-specific public-key retrieval and key revocation APIs require external credentials and policy.
The measured signature path is Python Ed25519 verification and excludes network, protobuf, TLS, disk, batching, and native acceleration effects.
